company.name: Storat
company.shortDescription: UAE online marketpace to build an online store, sell properties, advertise classifieds, jobs, and publish small business news
company.description:
Our mission is to web and mobile enable small businesses all over the middle east to help them reach millions of customers locally and overseas.

Our vision is to create a social ecommerce marketplace, where sellers and buyers are not locked inside and can communicate and transact freely on or off the market. Where the marketplace operator charges no margin, so sellers can provide their products and services at the lowest cost possible, while distinguishing themselves with a great brand, excellent customer service, and feedback.

We will make it easy for consumers and small businesses to setup online and mobile presence in minutes at no or very little cost with powerful, simple, and easy to use cloud-based solutions to connect with customers, run their business, and grow.

While our flagship product is a socially-enabled online marketplace, we are a technology company, a Cloud Distribution Company.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $385,870, or 30.01% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $200,000 to $5,502,359, a 27.51x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
